findings.reason: Input returns a consumed bool; nil/false keys and scrolling propagate. Actual KeyChord/Scroll tests pass five race repetitions and affected native-driver/consumer/native acceptance pass.
The chrome callback and all smoke model/camera mutations run inside owner(a,...), which calls Application.Do. Driver View and button callbacks and GPU Prepare/Draw use the same serialized owner.

Every resource-generation change goes through reset, invoking captured release before another Prepare. Cube release releases/nils group and pipeline including partial initialization. Resize changes target generation only and intentionally retains program resources.

findings.decision: physical-retention limitation clarified; proposed Destroy rejected
findings.reason: Budget estimates current framework-owned helper handles and checks old+new replacement peak, requiring program reference retirement. In-flight encoder/queue/native references and driver high-water are explicitly excluded. Destroy before submitting valid preparation commands could invalidate them.
